title: Fourteen Models and One Loose Screw
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术）　|　核心词汇：device　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 device 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the engineer ① built a device that no factory in the country would have produced, and he said the building was the whole of the workshop. The ② device, meaning the machine and not the method, ran fourteen models and stayed unlabelled on the bench; a device, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ device in that workshop had the same loose screw in the back of it, and the ④ device at the end, meaning the one they kept for the testing and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever repaired twice. A device, his assistant said, is nine parts trial and one part somebody willing to build; the engineer said the trial is the part that fills fourteen models.

The manager meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the device was the whole of the system, meaning the method and not the machine. The ⑥ device, meaning the method and not any of that, is the only thing in a system that everybody adopts and nobody explains; device, she said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a machine and a method. She said the method is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ device had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the loose screw. The ⑧ device of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in August, was one workshop and fourteen models of trial; device, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to build. She said the building was never mentioned.

The ⑨ device I remember is the one at the end, which was patented in 1977 and is still described as the strangest in the workshop. A ⑩ device, the assistant said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being tested; every device, she said, is a method that has agreed to look like a machine. She said the method was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 装置；仪器（指车间里做出来的那一台）
B. n. 装置（指那台机器本身，与那个方法相对）
C. 固定搭配：build a device 制作一台装置
D. n. 装置（指留给测试用的那一台）
E. n. 装置；器械（抽象总称，指一个车间的全部器械）
F. n. 装置（指产品目录上写到、被列名的那一台）
G. n. 手段；方法（指系统里被采用的那种办法）
H. n. 方法（抽象总称，指人人采用却无人解释的那种）

items.q: built a device that no factory in the country would have produced
The device, meaning the machine and not the method
the device was the whole of the system
the device had become a line in a catalogue
The device of the whole thing
A device, the assistant said in 1979

answers.why: build a device 意为“制作一台装置”，1955 年工程师制作了一台全国没有一家工厂肯生产的装置。
device 意为“装置”，指那台机器本身而不是那个方法，它做了十四个型号而在工作台上没有标牌。
device 意为“装置”，指那个车间里每一台装置，每一台背后都有同一颗松动的螺丝。
device 意为“装置”，指留给测试用的那一台，是唯一有人修理过两次的。
device 意为“手段、方法”，指系统里被采用的那种办法，经理说这种方法就是那个系统的全部。
device 意为“方法”，指人人采用却无人解释的那种而不是那台机器，是系统里人人都采用、却无人解释的东西。
device 意为“装置”，指产品目录上写到、被列名的那一台，到 1964 年这台装置成了目录里的一行。
device 意为“装置、器械”，工程师八月写道，整件事的器械是一个车间和十四个型号的试验。
device 意为“装置”，我记得的是末尾那一台，1977 年获得专利，至今仍被说成车间里最奇的一台。
device 为抽象总称，助手 1979 年说，一台装置是唯一会因为被测试而变得更好的东西。
